methodology.matrix_layout: Row-major protocol; implementation storage documented separately
methodology.timing: In-process monotonic timer; allocation and checksum included; startup, input creation, compilation and JSON excluded
methodology.warmup: max(5, min(iterations, 100)) operations before each timing sample; two calibration batches excluded
methodology.sampling: Serial runs, deterministic randomized implementation order each sample round; median and MAD reported
methodology.profiles: Separate instrumented or sampled runs; never used for comparative timings
methodology.limitations: These compare implementations and algorithms, not languages in isolation. Runtime/JIT/GC, compiler age, OS scheduling, thermals and allocation affect results. Small quick workloads are a smoke test, not a universal ranking.

implementations.name: WebAssembly
implementations.toolchain: emcc (Emscripten gcc/clang-like replacement + linker emulating GNU ld) 6.0.10 (d6c521a7f05449857c76bd99e396895583cf2083); Node.js v25.9.0
implementations.detail: C double matrix compiled with Emscripten; Node.js WebAssembly runtime; JS/WASM dispatch, allocation, checksum reads, and disposal included

profiles.note: V8 CPU profiler samples with recorded time deltas; chronological sample timeline. Includes Node startup, warmup, and measured workload in a separate run. Includes JavaScript wrapper and WebAssembly frames; optimized/inlined WASM functions may be merged or omitted.
